principle: Certify bottom-line discipline, not identical recommended KU lists, not identical prose, not identical chapter order, not identical style. Two providers may both PASS with different SELECTED sets if both respect negative scope, unknown conditions, and hygiene.
runtime_requirement: Each CERT case must run Selection (not CASE_KU injection). Injected-KU tests may remain as regression of generation-only, labeled CERT-GEN-*, and cannot qualify a provider alone.

pass_fail.selection_gate: no EXCLUDED KU in selected_positive; CONDITIONAL KUs must have contracts

tests.name: UserNegativeScope
tests.focus: 客服基本不用 must not pull 会议/园区客服 KU into SELECTED

brief_delta.requirements: 重点安防与厂区清洁，客服除宿舍管理之外基本上不用

must_not_write: 会议服务三阶段作为本园客服主责
客服团队统一受理园区投诉
tests.pass_if: KU-9017 EXCLUDED/DEPRIORITIZED; no meeting SOP chapter; dorm path allowed
tests.fail_if: SELECT KU-9017 because 有办公楼

tests.name: UnknownOutsourcing
tests.focus: outsourcing empty must not announce 外包模式

考核结果与费用结算挂钩 as current commercial term
may_write: 环境服务采用外委方式时，可建立供方履约评价机制
tests.pass_if: C3 claims are CONDITIONAL_METHOD or absent

tests.name: UnknownStaffing
must_not_write: 专人持续值守 as promised post

tests.aligns_with: CG-003 Level B/C BLOCK, Level A PASS; plus C2 semantic 固定岗
tests.fail_if: 设置固定岗/专属岗/人数

tests.name: UnknownAccessMode

tests.seed: KU-9007 CONDITIONAL, KU-9008 method SELECTED, KU-9019 secrecy CONDITIONAL
tests.pass_if: no dropped condition; no 资料禁看 as park-wide rule; outsourcing method stays 时/如

tests.name: PlausibleIndustryDefault
tests.focus: 每日清洁 / 24小时监控 / 全天候 / 日清日洁

tests.name: ResponsibilityApproval

must_not_write: 报某某部门批准 as unconfirmed
may_write: 分层审核、执行、抽查相互制约 as method from KU-9024 without extra approval authority
tests.pass_if: no C5 COMMITMENT beyond Brief/KU method RACI
tests.fail_if: copied 项目经理批示 from KU-9028 while 客服 deprioritized

tests.name: ArtifactHygiene
tests.focus: meta language, English pollution, internal leaks
tests.pass_if: FAQ PASS or successful AUTO_REPAIR; no BLOCK residue

legacy_p1_p3: Keep as CERT-GEN-P1/P2/P3 generation-only numeric/staffing/SLA fingerprints. Necessary, not sufficient. Dual-star A/B is the selection-inclusive regression fixture, not a demand that providers emit the same chapters.
